comment: Exercise 15.3: FMEA of the coincidence sorter. Severities are teaching choices (assumption: confirm with team).

rows.failure_mode: Boundary handled wrongly: singles at exactly the low or high limit are dropped or passed against the specification
rows.effect: Prompts and scatter fraction are biased slightly in every scan (H-07)
rows.cause: A strict comparison where the requirement says inclusive; a keV to LSB conversion that rounds
rows.detection: Unit test with singles on both limits

rows.failure_mode: Gate not applied: the configured window is ignored and a default is used
rows.effect: Scatter correction assumes a window the data was not acquired with (H-04, H-07)
rows.cause: The configuration reader does not pass the sorter settings on
rows.detection: Test that the configured sorter settings reach the sorter; the run record stores the effective configuration

rows.failure_mode: A single earlier than the previous one is accepted
rows.effect: Windows that are already closed miss their partner, or pairs form from the wrong singles (H-02)
rows.cause: The upstream merge breaks time order; the check compares against the wrong single
rows.detection: The out-of-order counter; the service ends the run in a fault

rows.failure_mode: Out-of-order singles dropped without being counted
rows.effect: Data is lost and the run is reported complete (H-01)
rows.cause: A counter not incremented on one code path
rows.detection: The accounting identity of the sorter's counters fails

rows.failure_mode: Window boundary off by one picosecond: a partner exactly one window later is missed or a later one is included
rows.effect: Prompts and randoms are biased in every scan (H-07)
rows.cause: A strict comparison where the requirement says less than or equal
rows.detection: Unit test with a partner exactly at the window

rows.failure_mode: Result depends on where the input is cut into batches
rows.effect: Coincidences differ between runs of the same data and between thread counts (H-07)
rows.cause: A window that spans two batches is closed at the batch end
rows.detection: Test that sorts the same singles in batches of every size

rows.failure_mode: Wrong policy applied, or a policy keeps the wrong pair
rows.effect: Prompts are biased at high rates, where multiples are frequent (H-07)
rows.cause: A missing case in a switch over the policies; the winner chosen by the wrong energy
rows.detection: Unit tests of each policy; comparison with the simulator's ground truth

rows.failure_mode: A tie between good pairs of equal summed energy is broken another way
rows.effect: The same singles give different coincidences in two versions of the sorter, so results cannot be reproduced or compared (H-07)
rows.cause: An optimization changes the loop order or the comparison; no requirement fixed the tie rule
rows.detection: None: no test fixes the tie rule, so a change to it passes every test
controls: NEW: When the take-winner-of-goods policy finds good pairs with equal summed energy, the coincidence sorter shall keep the pair with the earliest first single, and among those the earliest second single.

rows.failure_mode: Pairs inside one sector or outside the field of view are accepted, or good pairs rejected
rows.effect: Coincidences that cannot be real are reconstructed, or counts are lost (H-07)
rows.cause: Sector difference computed without the wrap around the ring; a field-of-view distance in the wrong unit
rows.detection: Unit tests at the sector wrap and at the field-of-view radius

rows.failure_mode: Delayed window opened at the wrong offset or with another width than the prompt window
rows.effect: The randoms estimate is biased, and so is the randoms correction of every scan (H-07)
rows.cause: The offset measured from the wrong single; the width taken from another setting
rows.detection: Test of the randoms estimate against the simulator's true randoms

rows.failure_mode: Windows still open at the end of a run are not closed
rows.effect: The last coincidences of every run are missing, without a counter (H-01)
rows.cause: flush() not called when the pipeline stops
rows.detection: Test that a stop processes all data already read; the accounting identity

rows.failure_mode: Counters do not account for every single
rows.effect: A loss inside the sorter is invisible to the integrity verdict (H-01)
rows.cause: A new path through the sorter without its counter
rows.detection: Test of the accounting identity on simulated data

rows.failure_mode: An invalid configuration is accepted: an empty energy window, a delay inside the prompt window, a field of view outside the ring
rows.effect: Coincidences are formed with settings that have no physical meaning (H-04, H-07)
rows.cause: A missing check in validate(); a check that accepts NaN
rows.detection: Unit test of every rejected configuration
